svg.title: Unknown-nuisance classification, refinement work and unsuccessful-fit fractions are compared with all failures retained.
svg.desc: Composite classification profiles the two unknown nuisance parameters rather than assuming known Gaussian means: three held-out mirror pairs, two amplitudes, two diffusivities, both source labels and 128 paired noise vectors give 3,072 classifications per condition. The work panel reports mean L-BFGS-B refinement objective calls over 2,048 inverse fits; it excludes coarse-grid preprocessing and is not a whole-program speed claim. The final panel retains selected grid fallbacks or unconverged fits; unsuccessful inner refinements are counted rather than discarded. Shared physical layouts reuse identical evaluations; duplicate method curves are not independent repetitions.
